provenance: User supplied Tripo drafts for this project; outfits generated in Tripo from the user’s own Gemini-edited sheets; no independent license assertion.
process: One shared bald base body (Tripo whole model, Mixamo 65-joint skin) dressed in layered items fitted onto it; the default outfit’s visible body pieces and items joined and welded, arms posed down 20.5° and taken as the bind pose, scaled to 1.7 m, Mixamo weights summed onto the 49 identity-axis runtime joints (four normalized influences); near and far LODs by decimation, one fresh unwrap baked into one atlas; lossless Meshopt geometry.
textureAtlas: One 2048x2048 RGB colour WebP per character baked from the items’ own textures, shared across LODs/instances. No normal or metallic-roughness maps. WebP reduces transfer only; KTX2 GPU compression is not applied.

source.generator: Tripo items on a shared base (user supplied)

limitations: Layered items joined into one surface; outfits are not swappable at runtime
Authored idle/walk/run/swim clips (src/world/art/characterClips.json); seated, machine and gesture poses procedural; no facial rig or cloth simulation
